column3: Settled midpack early - improved into 6th with 3f remaining - moved to front approaching 2f out looking comfortable - sent on and quickened away - powered through final furlong to score with plenty in hand

Settled midfield early - 9th with 3f left - driven up into 4th by 2f out - into second and pressed on approaching the last furlong and a half but couldn't threaten the runaway leader - held on for second without gaining further
Slow to break - held towards the back before making ground wide entering the 10th and asked for effort 2f out - moved up into 3rd with a furlong left - held on at an even effort to the line
Settled towards the back - progress to 8th three furlongs out and quickly under pressure - stayed on into 4th but never a danger
Sat close to the pace early - pushed along in 5th with two furlongs left - held that spot inside the final furlong but could not quicken - finished 5th beaten 9½ lengths

Settled close to the front - shared control from the 3f marker - kicked clear again with 2 1/2f left - lost command inside the final 2f then slipped to 4th with a furlong to run - unable to threaten again finishing 6th
Held up towards the back - pushed along and improved into 9th with 2f left - up to 6th inside the final furlong but couldn't find more
Held up towards the back - driven into 11th with 3f remaining - squeezed for space close to the rail approaching 2f out - stayed on at one pace late to finish 8th
Held up at the back - urged forward from the early stages - under pressure with 2f left - crept into 10th inside the final furlong but stayed held up
Sat close to the pace early - pushed along in 6th with 2f left - dropped away final stages - finished 10th
Settled just behind the front group - pressed for effort and slipped to 7th two out - faded late to finish 11th
Set the pace early - had company from 3f then pushed along and lost front spot with 2 1/2f left - dropped away to finish well held
Settled in the pack - pushed along in 8th with 2f left - dropped away late - finished well down the field
Settled towards the back - short of space around the turn with a furlong to go - flew through on the inside approaching the closing stages - hit the front inside the last 110yds and drew clear
Held second spot from the off - shared the front assignment entering the last furlong before being overtaken close home - stayed on to finish second beaten 1¾ lengths
Up with the pace - moved to front inside the final furlong before collared approaching the last 110yds - one-paced late to finish third
Held up towards the back - moved through wide approaching the home turn - kept on down the inner but unable to match the front three late
Held up handy early - dropped away under pressure 3f out - faded through final furlong to finish 5th
Held a midpack spot early - lost touch with the pack two out and drifted to find room - finished with a small late rally to be sixth beaten 5 lengths
Held up at the back - urged forward with under a furlong left - lost ground late and faded
Set the pace early - driven when overtaken with a furlong left - dropped away fast close home - finished 8th
Sluggish start - settled towards back of field - fell to last inside final two furlongs - well held at finish
Settled towards the back early - improved into contention after the 2nd - moved into second 4 out - hit the front approaching the final bend and kept going to the line
Settled off the pace early - clumsy over 8th - made progress into contention - moved into second before the turn - stayed on but no match for winner
Settled towards the back early - improved into third around the last turn - stayed on late without threatening the front pair
Went straight to front - held a big advantage in third until the last then lost that spot before the last turn - dropped away in the closing stages to finish 4th
Tracked the front group early - dropped away approaching 9th - found less by three out - kept going steadily to the line for fifth
Held up towards the back early - losing touch three out - trailed home late to finish sixth
Settled just behind the pace early - front-runner broke away 3rd - lost touch before 2 out - well held at the finish
Settled just off the pace in midpack - eased right and gained ground before 2 out - pressed forward to close in approaching the last - battled through the run-in - edged clear near the line

Sat behind front group early - dropped back 4th - urged forward after 7th - closed strongly before 3 out - kicked in front before 2 out - fought off rival approaching last and through run-in - overtaken close home to finish second
Settled at back of field - travelling comfortably 3 out - roused before 2 out - into third on run-in - kept on to finish third

Settled in the pack early - moved up into fourth and stayed on terms with the front group - slipped back a fraction three out - driven back into touch with the pace two out - hit the final fence and faded away on the run-in
Settled at the back early - pushed for effort approaching 3 out - unable to threaten leaders - finished fifth
Went straight to front - pressed for effort and lost command before 2 out - dropped away approaching the last - finished sixth well beaten
Settled just behind the pace - pressed for effort then dropped away in a hurry approaching 3 out - well held at the finish
Sat in second early - roused two out - challenged for front spot into final furlong and a half - hit the front with a furlong remaining - dug deep to prevail in a tight finish
Sat close to the pace early - pushed along in 3rd inside final 2f before moving up to 2nd in the last furlong - stayed on gamely and just failed to reel in winner
Set the pace early fighting for control - shaken up to draw level around 1½f out - overhauled with a furlong left - dropped to 3rd inside the final furlong - unable to find more and held that spot
Sat close up on the rail early - pushed along with 2f remaining and up in 4th a furlong out - held the effort to the line finishing 4th beaten 2.5 lengths
Sat close to the pace early - pushed into 3rd two furlongs out - eased back to 5th late and could not find more
Held up towards the back of the pack - pushed along wide in 12th two out - improved to 7th inside final furlong but couldn't find more - finished 6th
Sluggish start - settled at back before improving into 9th under pressure 2f out - couldn't find more late and finished 7th
Settled around midpack - pressed for effort in 10th with 2f left - unable to close - finished 8th beaten 6 lengths
Held midfield wide - pushed along in 8th two out - improved to 6th final furlong but no further headway - finished ninth beaten 6 lengths
Held up towards the back - pushed along with 2f left - shuffled up slightly in the closing stages but always held
Slow to break - settled towards the back - pushed along with 2f left but unable to close - crept on late to finish 11th
Sat close to the pace early - pressed for effort in 6th with 2f to run - dropped away toward the finish - eventually came home 12th
Settled in the pack pulling hard early - pushed along with 2f left - faded to finish well held in 13th
Held up towards the back - unable to make headway from 2f out - dropped away late to finish 14th
Held up in the pack on the rail - pushed along and up to 5th on the inner two out - dropped away late to finish 15th
Hesitant start - stayed towards the back of the field - unable to threaten leaders late on and well held
Settled just behind the front-runner early - closed in approaching the final furlong - edged ahead close home - won going away
Sent clear early on a fierce gallop - pushed along inside final furlong - couldn't quicken again when caught close home
Sat fourth early - pressed for effort inside final furlong and moved into third close home - unable to match the front two in the closing strides
Sat third early - driven approaching final furlong then unable to quicken - dropped a spot near the line to finish fourth
Sluggish start - settled at back and gave ground early - well beaten by the final furlong - finished fifth
Settled in the pack early - made progress into contention before moving up to second approaching four out - hit the front near the home turn - kept finding through the finish to score

Settled at back of field - error at 8th - made ground into contention by 14th - drifted right and clipped opponent turning for home - moved into second inside final 110 yards and kept on to finish 2nd
Settled towards the back early - improved into contention after the 14th - stumbled three out then bumped rounding the home turn - stayed on into third but couldn't close inside the last furlong
Set the pace early - clipped one at the 7th and again 3 out - lost front spot approaching the home turn then dropped away close to the line
Settled close up early - dropped away before four out - eased and pulled up before the last
Settled behind the pace early - dropped away after the 2nd - slipped further back through the field - still adrift approaching the 15th - eased out of it before the last
Sluggish start - sat behind the pace without going smoothly - up to third - needed rousting along at the 8th - stumbled at the 13th - lost touch before three out and pulled up
Up with the early pace - lost momentum around the 13th and dropped away - a remote last before 4 out - retired before 2 out
Set the pace from the off - shaken off rivals early - eased home unchallenged
Spun about at the off - never got competitive - trailed the field the whole way - finished second well beaten
Settled behind leader early - jumping first swerved off line and rider came out of the saddle
Held up at the back early - improved into midfield by 4f - moved into second under good pace 2f out - hit front 1 1/2f out and pushed on strongly to the line

Sat close up early in second - hit front three furlongs out and asked for effort soon after - challenged hard with two to run - overtaken a furlong and a half from home - held on for second at an even effort late
Sat close behind the front group early - pushed along into 4th around 2f out then up to 3rd inside final furlong and a half - stayed on at an even effort to finish 3rd

Held up towards back of pack - progress made 4f out - pushed along to move into 3rd 2f out - dropped to 4th with a furlong and a half left - unable to close on front-runners and stayed on same speed to finish 4th
Sat close to the front group early - pushed along in 4th two out then slipped to 5th inside the final furlong - unable to close on the front-runners
Held up at back - urged into effort with 5f left - pressed for response 3f out - still adrift in seventh 2f out and unable to close home
Slow to break - hit front straight away - urged to keep tempo by halfway - collared 3f out and faded from there
Settled in the pack early fighting for control - dropped towards the back of the group by the 4th - pressed for effort with 3f left - dropped away and finished well beaten
Held up in the pack early - began to close a furlong out then found running to third close home - flat out and got up in the closing strides
Struck the front early - driven approaching final 2f and again inside the last - caught close home despite maximum effort
Close up with the pace early - asked for effort with 2f left and moved into third inside the final furlong - stayed on strongly near the line but flattened out close home
Held second early - dropped back inside final furlong - faded close home to finish 4th
Handy with front group early - lost ground two out - dropped away inside final furlong - finished fifth beaten 3.75L
Held up towards the back - pushed along with a furlong left then lost placings - lost more ground close home to finish sixth
Held up towards the back - progress made in the closing stages - finished off well - eventually 7th beaten 5.5 lengths
Sat close to the pace - urged forward two out then lost ground one out - dropped away fast inside final furlong
Sluggish start - settled towards back and stayed there until closing stages - nudged into contention final furlong before fading late
held up in the pack - lost touch two out and dropped away inside the final furlong to finish tenth
Held a forward position out wide - lost momentum 2f out - dropped away quickly after
Sluggish start - held up at back of field - lost touch from 2f out and beaten well before the line
Set the pace early - lost the advantage briefly at the third and pushed back over the run-in - dug deep to force back in front close home for the win
Sat behind the front pack early - moved up to second three out then hit the front on the run-in - overtaken close home to finish second
Settled towards back early - pushed along two out then drifted right and lost fluency approaching last - unable to quicken with front pair - moved into third close home
Handy on inner early - moved up to second by the 9th and held that spot until 3 out - gave way on the run-in and dropped to fourth close home
Held up towards the back - stumbled at the 9th - made ground wide two out - lost momentum after the last and faded late
Held a forward position early - lost ground two out - dropped away steadily to finish sixth

Settled at the back early - untidy over 7th - gradual progress from 9th - urged forward before 3 out - stumbled 2 out but continued to close - surged into contention approaching the last - driven out and battled up the run-in - got up close home to score

Settled in the pack early - improved onto the front group after 4th - shifted right approaching 9th - roused for effort before 3 out - moved into second before 2 out - hit the front soon after - fought back gamely but caught close to home
Handy early - urged on after 9th - hit front before 3 out - overtaken before 2 out - fought back to challenge before last - faded near finish to finish third
Settled towards the back early - scrappy over 2nd and 5th - gradually closed ground before 3 out - pushed along after that - unable to threaten those in front near the last - stayed on to finish 4th
Went straight to the front - pushed along and lost the advantage before 3 out - dropped away before 2 out - finished well held in 5th
Up with the leaders - needed pushing after the 9th - lost touch before 3 out and well adrift at the finish
Never travelled with any rhythm - settled at the back of the field - dropped away before 3 out - well beaten in 7th
Up with the front group early - fell back and given a reminder after the 4th - pushed harder from the 7th before fading to the back of the field after the 8th - well adrift before 3 out to finish 8th

Held up in the pack early - needed encouragement after the 1st - slipped back through the field by the 4th and adrift by the 6th - jumped awkwardly and nearly parted company at the 8th - well beaten from the 9th
Settled with the pack early - blundered at the 7th - pushed for effort and fell back before 3 out - beaten when eased and withdrawn before the last
Set the pace early on a tight rein - pressed and drawn level with two furlongs left - kicked back in front approaching the final furlong - powered clear to the line
Slow into stride - settled second early on a tight grip - shared front spot going strongly over 2f out - pushed along soon after - overtaken a furlong out - stayed on at an even effort to the line
Settled towards rear early - pressed for effort in 5th with 2f left - found room to move into 3rd inside the final furlong and stayed on to finish third
Sat handy behind the front pack early - pushed along in 3rd approaching the furlong pole but unable to close - held that spot to the line for 4th
Settled just off the pace in 5th - pressed for effort with 2f remaining - stayed on late to finish 5th

Settled behind the front group early while pulling hard - squeezed for space 2f out - pushed along into 4th - held that spot a furlong out - unable to close and finished 6th beaten just under three lengths
Settled off the pace early - quickened smartly into contention 2f out - hit the front approaching the final bend - opened up a big advantage - kept up the effort to the line unchallenged
Settled in second early - held that spot through the race - lost ground to the winner inside the final furlong - stayed on to finish second
Settled towards the back - pushed along to close in 2f out - moved into third with a furlong left and stayed on to finish
Held up towards the back - nudged into contention inside final furlong - stayed on to finish fourth
Settled in third early - driven onward when dropping back with 2f left - faded through closing stages to finish fifth
Held handy early - pressed for effort 2f out and quickly found wanting - lost ground steadily inside final furlong to finish sixth
Went forward early to command - dictated modest gallop - overtaken on the second bend out - dropped away entering the last furlong
Held up towards the back - lost touch with the pack four furlongs out - allowed to drop away well adrift approaching the final furlong - finished well beaten in 8th
Settled in the pack - made ground into contention approaching 2 out - hit the front on the run to the last - powered away up the run-in for a comfortable win

Tracked the pace - hit the second last awkwardly - moved into contention and hit the front approaching the final fence - blundered there and lost the advantage - unable to get on terms with the winner after that
Held command early before yielding at the 3rd - regained front spot until 2 out then overtaken - held on for third but unable to threaten winner up the run-in
Settled at the back early - improved into fourth by the final flight - couldn't close on the leaders late
Settled in the back markers - crept into contention approaching two out - lost momentum before the final fence and finished well beaten
Tracked pace-setter early - dropped away 3rd - lost touch 5th - faded before 2 out - well held at finish
Sat behind pace early - dropped away and sluggish over first before running towards the back - toiling by three out
Pulling hard early - close up then in front from 3rd - lost command 3 out - dropped away rapidly after and beaten a long way home
Settled in the pack - crept forward wide 2 out but couldn't close the gap - beaten from the last home ninth
Sat behind pace early - moved into second spot 4 out - shaken up to hit front before 3 out - urged on approaching last and cleared it well - fended off pressure up the run-in - prevailed by a whisker

Held a forward position early - lost place 14th and lost touch briefly - pushed on after 4 out but couldn't threaten those in front by 2 out - found renewed energy approaching the last - kept going well and edged left up the run-in - grabbed second spot right at the line

Held up towards the back - made smooth progress from the 12th before moving into second before two out - pressed for the lead approaching the last and edged in front there - battled on but was denied in the final strides finishing third
Settled with the main group early - lost ground and urged forward after the 14th - driven on four out - progressed steadily approaching two out - finished the stronger without threatening the front

Held up towards the back - hampered at the first - not jumping cleanly 3rd - urged forward before 4 out and made progress before 3 out - unable to threaten the front-runners from 2 out - kept battling to the line
Settled off the pace - urged forward before 3 out - outpaced with front group and awkward at last - stayed on to finish sixth
Held a leading position early - pressed for effort after 4 out but unable to close on the pace-setters 2 out - dropped away in the closing stages - finished seventh

Dropped out at the back - erratic jump at the 1st causing interference - untidy at the 14th - roused 4 out - pushed along after 3 out - out of contention with the front group before the last and faded to finish 8th
Tracked the front group early - dropped back after the 14th and soon under pressure - well held when heavily hampered 2 out - finished 9th
Set the pace early - urged to keep up effort before 4 out - overtaken before 3 out and dropped away rapidly before 2 out
Settled towards the back - still with a lot of ground to make up - stumbled and came down two out
Held up towards the back - hampered at the 1st - still in the tail of the pack after 5th - dropped further back after 13th - short-lived improvement after 14th - faded and eased down before 3 out
Settled midpack early - urged and slipped back after the 14th - faded to the tail before being pulled up after four out
Sat second early - hit the front in fine style two out and asserted with a shake-up to open a healthy advantage inside the final furlong - kept finding more without hard driving to score

Sat behind the front group - pushed along in 3rd approaching 2f out then moved up to 2nd inside the final furlong but could not challenge the winner - stayed on late to finish second beaten three quarters of a length
Held up early - improved into 5th under pressure with 2f left - into 4th 1f out - up to 3rd inside final furlong and finished strongly without quite closing further
Settled in 5th early and pulling hard - pushed along into 4th 2f out - dropped to 5th with a furlong left - rallied back to 4th close home - finished 4th unable to find more
Sent to the front early - pressed for effort and lost command two out then chased the new leader inside the final furlong - slipped back to finish fifth without threatening late
Dwelt badly and rooted to the rear - urged to improve into the final two furlongs - made no dent on the group ahead - well held in 6th
Sat close to the front group in 4th - urged forward with 3f left - lost touch soon after and dropped away - finished 7th
Went straight to front - dictated with a firm gallop throughout - edged clear inside final furlong - powered home under no urging - crossed the line clear
Handy early travelling wide - moved into second before halfway - stayed on outside winner's berth from a furlong out - held on well but couldn't close final furlong
Handy early and keen going while nudged at the first turn - tracking the front two from 3f out - lost touch and pressed for effort 2f out - stayed on late but couldn't close finishing third
Handy near front - driven approaching 2f out then unable to match top three - stayed on at same rate inside final furlong to finish fourth
Settled in the pack from the start - unable to improve position throughout - held for pace at the finish - came home fifth
Drifted left at the break - settled midpack and wide of rivals - made progress on the pace three out - pushed along two out - lost momentum inside the last and beaten home
Held up towards the back - lost touch with leading group two furlongs out - dropped away in closing stages - finished seventh
Held up at the back - lost touch from 3f out - dropped away in the closing stages - finished 8th
Settled towards the back - lost touch two out - finished with a late flourish to close but well beaten in 9th
Dwelt and checked at the start - dropped to the back of the field and came under pressure from 2f out - weakened inside the final furlong to finish 10th
Settled in the pack - lost touch with leading group 2f out - dropped away sharply in closing stages to finish 11th
Held a forward position early - lost ground from 2f out - dropped away inside final furlong - finished 12th well held
Settled at the back early - made progress after 2 out - up to third by the last - shifted right to take second inside final 150 yards - finished strongly to get up on the line
Settled just off the pace early - moving well through the contest - improved into second two out then took command - two lengths ahead after the final fence - caught in the last strides
Handy in behind - scratchy over 7th - urged along approaching last - closed on front pair late to finish third narrowly behind
Settled midpack early - pushed along two out but found little late on - fourth and unable to threaten leaders before final flight
Sat behind the front group early - faded before 3 out and dropped to the rear - kept plodding on late
Held up around midfield throughout - unable to make headway from 2 out - well held at the finish
Went in front early - settled just off the pace after being headed - scratchy jump 5th - urged forward before 3 out then faded before the last

Held a forward spot early - went ahead 2nd and opened daylight by 8th - hit a rough patch 3 out - advantage shrinking approaching last two - overtaken and lost momentum - stumbled at the final fence and trailed home
Jumped a bit untidily early - held up towards the back - dropping away with 3 to jump - eventually finished ninth
Held up towards rear - hit 6th and losing touch by 3 out - eased and pulled up before the last
Held up mid-pack - still behind with 3 to jump - eased and pulled up before the final fence

Set the pace from the off - opened a big lead after the 4th before the gap narrowed by the 7th - stretched away again past four out - under pressure and margin shrank again after the second-last - pressed close home - battled on strongly to prevail
Settled at the back early - began to make progress from 4 out - up into second before 3 out - pushed along approaching final furlong - fought hard inside the last but narrowly denied
Handy early - shadowing front-runner after the 4th - narrowed gap before the 7th - pushed along to renew pursuit before 3 out - dropped to third before 2 out and held no more late
Settled behind the front group - made progress after the 5th before pressed for effort past four out - lost ground from three out to finish fourth
Sat fourth early - roused after the 8th and again approaching 4 out - lost ground before 3 out to finish fifth
Held up towards the back - began toiling from the 8th - dropped away approaching 4 out - well held at the finish
Held up towards back of pack - improved into 7th with 2f to run - asked for effort and hit front with a furlong left - finished strongly to score
Sat behind pace early - moved through to challenge approaching 2f out and hit the front looking strong - asked for effort soon after - overtaken a furlong out - stayed on for second
Held up towards the back early - urged for effort with 2f left holding 10th - moved into 5th a furlong out - improved into 3rd close home - stayed on to finish third
Settled in the pack early - improved into 5th and asked for effort 2f out - up to 4th with a furlong left - stayed on at one gear to finish fourth

Set the pace from the start - drawn level at the midpoint then pressed for effort and lost command approaching the last three furlongs - sat third with two to run - unable to close on the front pair late finishing fifth beaten 5 lengths
Sat close up early in second - shared front spot at halfway - pushed along and lost the advantage 2f out - dropped to third final furlong and unable to close finished sixth
Held up in midfield - pushed along in 9th with 2f left - unable to make headway - finished 7th
Sat close to the pace early - pushed along in 4th with 2f left - lost ground late to finish 8th
Settled in the pack - pushed along in 8th with 2f left - stayed there to the finish without threatening
Held up towards the back - pushed along in 11th with 2f left - unable to close - finished well beaten
Settled at the back early - made no impression through the race - finished well held in 11th
Settled just off the front group along the rail - pushed along and slipped to 6th over 2f out - faded through the closing stages to finish 12th
Struggled to keep tabs from the off - lost more ground two out - finished well adrift

Handy early up with the pace - eased back to mid-division by halfway - looking for space and switched wide approaching final furlong - finished powerfully to hit the front inside the last - driven out close home - prevailed by the narrowest of margins
Settled at the back early - angled through mid-track and began motoring over a furlong out - stayed on strongly to grab second inside the last 110yds - couldn't quite peg back the winner close home
Handy in the pack - wide on the turn 2f out - closed strongly inside the final furlong - grabbed third close home

Settled in the pack - wide route through the race - given a squeeze for effort with 2f left and edged left under pressure inside the last - form gave way close home to finish fourth beaten a length and a quarter
Went straight to front - pace rival came alongside at halfway before pushed back in command 2f out - overtaken entering last furlong - lost momentum close home to finish fifth
Handy near the front - driven approaching final furlong - faded close home - finished sixth
Held mid-pack early - lost touch with leaders inside final furlong - dropped away late to finish seventh
Sluggish break then settled into a handy spot behind the pace after the opening furlong - asked for effort 3f from home - faded quickly - beaten off by the final furlong finishing eighth
Dwelt at the off - soon up with the front group and contesting the head of affairs from halfway - ridden 2f out - dropped away over 1f out - hamperd inside the final furlong and beaten into 9th
Tardy at the start - dropped to the back of the field - faded in the closing stages to finish 10th

Settled just off the pace early - made ground into 8th - went up to dispute the lead 2 out - hit the front soon after - opened a big advantage inside the final furlong - kept going strongly to score with ease
Settled midpack - clumsy over 2nd then dropped rearward - rallied approaching final two - moved into runner-up spot before last - held no threat to winner late
Held up in the pack - pushed along 3 out - lost ground 2 out - moved into third after the last but kept on without threatening
Settled off the pace in the pack - clipped the opening obstacle - improved into contention before the 8th - stumbled at the final fence then dropped away quickly to finish fourth
Settled towards the back - nudged into contention 3 out - unable to threaten leaders - dropped away before last and stayed on to finish 5th
Sat behind the pace early - clumsy at the 7th and hesitant over the following obstacle - moved into second three out - hit the front for a moment - held nothing more approaching the last
Went in front early - lost the advantage before two out - dropped away approaching the last
Settled midpack early - made progress before blundering three out - dropped away after two out - eventually finished eighth
Sent to the front early - handed up spot behind rival before the first - dropped away approaching two out - well held at the finish
Handy in the early stages - dropped away before 3 out and fell far behind - pulled up before the last
Sat behind front two early - moved into second alone by the 4th - closed on the front-runner after 3 out - took over comfortably 2 out - eased away on the run-in to score readily

Broke to the right and pulled hard early - hit the front - drifted markedly right at the 3rd - matched up with rival after 3 out then lost command 2 out - lost ground before the last - dropped away to finish second
Held up at the rear - well behind at the 2nd - bumped 4th - pushed along and dropped away before 2 out and finished well adrift
Held second early - jinked right abruptly and threw rider at the 4th
Settled midpack early - urged into contention around 6th then 4th inside final furlong - finished strongly to hit the front late and win
Sat behind the pace - went ahead with two furlongs left - pushed along at the furlong and a half marker - challenged hard inside the final furlong - stayed on but caught right at the line

Sat behind the front group early - urged into 4th 2f from home - shaken up to move 3rd inside final two - up to 2nd a furlong out - challenged hard in the closing stages but flattened out to finish third
Handy early - asked for effort 2f out then chased leader inside final 2 furlongs - dropped to 3rd 1f out and 4th late - held on for fourth without further progress
Held up towards the back - pushed along to move up into 7th with 2f left and 6th approaching the final furlong - stayed on at one speed to the line finishing 5th
Slow to break - held towards the back - pushed along in 8th with 2f left and unable to close - finished sixth beaten 4.5 lengths
Went straight to the front - pressed for effort and lost command 2f out - dropped away to finish seventh
Handy early behind pace-setters - pushed along into 5th two furlongs out - slipped back and faded through final furlong to finish 8th
Held up towards the back - pushed along and lost ground 2f out - eventually finished 9th
Settled in the pack early - moved up wide after the turn for home - hit the front on the bend 2f out - opened a big advantage into the last furlong - stayed on strongly to win comfortably
Settled in the pack - shifted wide and began closing from 2f out - lots left to accomplish entering the last furlong - finished strongly to grab second close home
Handy from the start - close to the front pair into the last two furlongs - lost momentum a furlong out - drifted left-ward inside the final furlong - stayed on well to grab third close home
Settled towards the back early - fighting for control under restraint - driven into contention inside the final furlong - stayed on to finish fourth
Settled just behind the pace early - still close up entering final 2f - pushed along a furlong out - lost ground late to finish 5th

Went straight to front and dictated a steady gallop - pushed along after being passed on the turn approaching final furlong - lost touch with winner inside last - drifted right and faded to finish sixth
Held up close to the pace - urged forward with 2f left - faded close home
Settled at the back of the field - faded final furlong to finish well behind in 8th
Settled close up in second early - driven to keep tabs but slipped back 2f out - dropped away final furlong
Settled in the pack - lost touch with the leading group two furlongs out - dropped away rapidly inside the final furlong - finished well held in 10th
Held up towards the back - slipped further away two furlongs out and finished well adrift

Settled with the pack early - dropped away from the front after the 5th - made up places approaching 3 out - pressed the pace at the last - hit the front soon after - drew away in the final furlong and a half to score comfortably

Jumped a touch untidily early - settled in the pack - made steady headway from fourth - moved up into second before two out - hit the front approaching the last - blundered there and was put back in front soon after before unable to match winner's finish in the final furlong and a half
Set the pace to the 3rd - remained close up before fading after 2 out - beaten into third near the finish
